segments.name: Engine Services
segments.description: Provides aftermarket maintenance, repair and overhaul of gas turbine engines and airframes for commercial aerospace, military, helicopter and business aviation customers.
segments.evidence: Our Engine Services segment provides a full suite of aftermarket services, including maintenance, repair and overhaul, on-wing and field service support, asset management, and engineering and related solutions to customers in the commercial aerospace, military and helicopter, and business aviation end markets.

segments.name: Component Repair Services
segments.description: Repairs engine components and accessories and provides repair development engineering for commercial aerospace, military and other customers.
segments.evidence: Our Component Repair Services segment provides engine component and accessory repairs to commercial aerospace, military and other end markets.

revenueModel.text: Aircraft operators, lessors and manufacturers pay StandardAero for engine overhaul, component repair, field support and related engineering services.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue in the Engine Services segment is primarily derived from the repair and overhaul of a wide variety of gas turbine engines and auxiliary power units that power fixed and rotary wing aircraft.
